Built from the Ministry of Finance Fiscal Data workbooks, the summary of central government
operations, 2008 to July 2026. It runs entirely in your browser, so the first load takes a few
seconds while R starts up.
[Open it full screen](/dashboards/fiscal-explorer-app/index.html) if the frame is cramped.

::: {.column-screen-inset}
<iframe src="/dashboards/fiscal-explorer-app/index.html"
        style="width:100%; height:1150px; border:1px solid #E7DECB; border-radius:4px;"
        loading="lazy"
        title="Ghana Fiscal Explorer">
</iframe>
:::

Source code and the full database: [github.com/aappiah17](https://github.com/aappiah17). Data: Ministry
of Finance, Fiscal Data ([mofep.gov.gh/fiscal-data](https://www.mofep.gov.gh/fiscal-data)); GDP ratios
use World Bank nominal GDP.
